name: Custom Shape 3D Acrylic Display Case
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality acrylic, offering a bright, modern, and durable display finish.
    - Features a 3D acrylic display case construction that creates a layered and eye-catching presentation for personalized artwork.
    - Made entirely from 3mm acrylic, providing a sturdy yet lightweight structure for long-term display use.
    - Includes multiple acrylic panels and custom acrylic pieces that work together to form a dimensional showcase.
    - Smooth cut edges and clear acrylic surfaces enhance the artwork with a clean and polished appearance.
    - Designed to combine decorative display, personalization, and protective presentation in one product.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall size: 4 x 6 in ~ 10.14 x 15.24 cm
    - Side depth: 2.2 in ~ 5.6 cm
    - Inner display height: 4.81 in ~ 12.21 cm
    - Custom pieces:
                +) Minimum size for a single piece: 2 cm
                +) Supports up to 5 separate pieces
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Uses advanced UV printing technology for sharp details, vibrant colors, and long-lasting image quality.
    -  Features double-sided printing on all the acrylic panels and acrylic pieces.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Functions as a personalized display case and decorative keepsake.
    - Designed to showcase custom characters, family themes, pets, hobbies, or meaningful artwork in a dimensional format.
    - Suitable for desks, shelves, countertops, office tables, and decorative display corners.
    - The enclosed acrylic structure helps create a neat, polished, and eye-catching presentation.
    - Perfect for home décor, office décor, celebration displays, and personalized keepsake collections.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A meaningful personalized gift for dads, family members, friends, coworkers, and loved ones.
    - Perfect for Father’s Day, birthdays, anniversaries, holidays, and special celebrations.
    - Ideal for family-themed gifts, pet lover gifts, and custom decorative keepsakes.
    - A thoughtful gift for preserving names, memories, and meaningful moments in a creative display format.
    - Great for desk décor, shelf decoration, and commemorative gift giving.
    - Adds a fun, personal, and memorable touch to any space🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment, and all designs are updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1x Custom Shape 3D Acrylic Display Case

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • Tracking Country Origin is US

 

NOTE

  • Actual color may be slightly different from the image due to different monitor and light effects.
  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

 

  • Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. 
  • Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 
  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

 

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

 

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
